top_choice_rationale: P003 (B002: Chetty, Hendren, Friedman) is the clearest case of measurement and identification done together. Population-scale linked records measure mobility directly, and the movers and exposure-effect designs test place effects causally. Because the descriptive and causal strands can check each other, I trust the core findings even though outsiders cannot re-run the restricted files. I treat restricted data access and the roughly decade-old record as a real discount on maturity, not a caveat, and I see the gap to P001 as small. P001 (B038, narrowed to the trade-exposure and local-adjustment evidence, with Dorn as third name) has the longer record of independent replication and critique. It would lead if durability and external verifiability are weighted first. P002 (B001) is the strongest case on conceptual maturity and clean credit, but its empirical content is indirect. P005 (B041) has good firm-level empirical grounding but contested attribution, with Bernard, Eaton, Jensen and Kortum uncredited, and specification-dependent welfare estimates. P004 (B013) has the cleanest credit but a mixed record on the specific Protection for Sale predictions. P000 is last because every slate proposal rests on a valid, mature contribution.
